arxiv-2109-01274.title: UserBERT: Contrastive User Model Pre-training
arxiv-2109-01274.creator: Chuhan Wu Fangzhao Wu Yang Yu Tao Qi Yongfeng Huang Xing Xie
arxiv-2109-01274.description: Abstract User modeling is critical for personalized web applications. Existing user modeling methods usually train user models from user behaviors with task-specific labeled data. However, labeled data in a target task may be insufficient for training accurate user models. Fortunately, there are usually rich unlabeled user behavior data which encode rich information of user characteristics and interests.

arxiv-2111-03161.title: Status of the DEAP-3600 experiment
arxiv-2111-03161.creator: Marcin Kuźniak for the DEAP-3600 collaboration
arxiv-2111-03161.description: Abstract DEAP-3600 is a single-phase liquid argon (LAr) dark matter detector, located 2 km underground at SNOLAB in Sudbury, Canada, which started taking data in 2016. The detector is sensitive to nuclear recoils induced by scattering of dark matter particles, which would cause emission of prompt scintillation light.

arxiv-2306-03602.title: TestLab: An Intelligent Automated Software Testing Framework
arxiv-2306-03602.creator: Tiago Dias, Arthur Batista Eva Maia, Isabel Praça
arxiv-2306-03602.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Tiago Dias, Arthur Batista Eva Maia, Isabel Praça. The prevalence of software systems has become an integral part of modern-day living. Software usage has increased significantly, leading to its growth in both size and complexity. Consequently, software development is becoming a more time-consuming process. In an attempt to accelerate the development cycle, the testing phase is often neglected, leading to the deployment of flawed systems that can have significant implications on the users daily activities.

arxiv-2503-02611.creator: Parker Knight, Ndey Isatou Jobe, Rui Duan
arxiv-2503-02611.description: Abstract Statistical integration of diverse data sources is an essential step in the building of generalizable prediction tools, especially in precision health. The invariant features model is a new paradigm for multi-source data integration which posits that a small number of covariates affect the outcome identically across all possible environments.

arxiv-2507-00037.creator: Phoomraphee Luenam, Andreas Spanopoulos, Amit Sant, Thomas Hofmann, Sotiris Anagnostidis, Sidak Pal Singh
arxiv-2507-00037.description: Abstract Model fusion aims to combine the knowledge of multiple models by creating one representative model that captures the strengths of all of its parents. However, this process is non-trivial due to differences in internal representations, which can stem from permutation invariance, random initialization, or differently distributed training data.

arxiv-2511-11698.title: Moirai 2.0: When Less Is More for Time Series Forecasting
arxiv-2511-11698.creator: Chenghao Liu Taha Aksu Juncheng Liu Xu Liu Hanshu Yan Quang Pham Silvio Savarese Doyen Sahoo Caiming Xiong Junnan Li Salesforce AI Research https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/uni2ts https://huggingface.co/Salesforce/moirai-2.0-R-small
arxiv-2511-11698.description: Abstract We introduce Moirai 2.0, a decoder-only time-series foundation model trained on a new corpus of 36M series. The model adopts quantile forecasting and multi-token prediction, improving both probabilistic accuracy and inference efficiency. On the Gift-Eval benchmark, it ranks among the top pretrained models while achieving a strong trade-off between accuracy, speed, and model size. Compared to Moirai 1.

pmc-10531519.title: Effects of Mobilization within 72 h of ICU Admission in Critically Ill Patients: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
pmc-10531519.creator: Ayaka Matsuoka, Shodai Yoshihiro, Haruka Shida, Gen Aikawa, Yoshihisa Fujinami, Yusuke Kawamura, Nobuto Nakanishi, Motohiro Shimizu, Shinichi Watanabe, Kensuke Sugimoto, Shunsuke Taito, Shigeaki Inoue, Chiara Lazzeri
pmc-10531519.description: Previous systematic review and meta-analysis indicates that rehabilitation within a week of intensive care unit (ICU) admission benefits physical function in critically ill patients. This updated systematic review and meta-analysis aim to clarify effects of initiating rehabilitation within 72 h of ICU admission on long-term physical, cognitive, and mental health.

pmc-10583701.title: Carbon–carbon bond activation by Mg, Al, and Zn complexes
pmc-10583701.creator: Joseph M. Parr, Mark R. Crimmin
pmc-10583701.description: Examples of carbon–carbon bond activation reactions at Mg, Al, and Zn are described in this review. Several distinct mechanisms for C–C bond activation at these metals have been proposed, with the key C–C bond activation step occurring by (i) α-alkyl elimination, (ii) β-alkyl elimination, (iii) oxidative addition, or (iv) an electrocyclic reaction.

pmc-11688292.title: Association of cardiovascular health with cognitive function and the mediating effect of depressive state
pmc-11688292.creator: Yiwei Hu, Xuelu Sun, Chen Guo, Ruiyun Wu, Jiahao Dou, Shoufang Song, Fanshun Guo, Jin Wei
pmc-11688292.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundAlthough previous research has substantiated lifestyle and cardiovascular-related measures have some impact on cognitive function, studies focusing on the correlation between Life’s Essential 8 (LE8), an indicator for quantifying cardiovascular health (CVH), and cognitive function are limited. Consequently, this study sought to explore the potential link between CVH and cognitive function as well as to determine if depressive states mediated the relationship.MethodsA total of 2,263 individuals were selected from the 2011–2014 National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES).

pmc-12595788.title: The dysbiosis of gut microbiota in major depressive disorder and comorbidity with overweight/obesity: unraveling biomarkers and metabolic pathways from a microbial perspective
pmc-12595788.creator: Bing Cao, Chenxuan Lu, Lailai Yan, Roger S McIntyre, Kayla M Teopiz, Lu Zhan
pmc-12595788.description: BackgroundMajor depressive disorder (MDD), a leading global public health concern, exhibits high comorbidity with overweight/obesity. While emerging evidence implicates shared gut microbial dysregulation in both conditions, the identification of specific microbial biomarkers and their interaction with metabolic pathways in comorbid MDD-obesity remains poorly characterized.

pmc-12723912.title: Women’s healthcare needs and access across the incarceration pathway in Israel: a qualitative study
pmc-12723912.creator: Nisreen Agbaria, Heino Stöver, Nadav Davidovitch, Shannon A McMahon, Volker Winkler, Kate Bärnighausen
pmc-12723912.description: BackgroundWithin punitive, under-resourced, and male-dominated incarceration systems, the healthcare needs of incarcerated women are often overlooked and inadequately addressed. This study aimed to explore the healthcare needs and access to care among formerly incarcerated women in Israel.MethodsWe employed an exploratory-descriptive qualitative design, and interviews were conducted with eighteen formerly incarcerated women, purposively recruited from the Prisoner Rehabilitation Authority in Israel.

pmc-12751566.title: Intake of dietary carotenoids and flavonoids at midlife and risk of physical frailty at late life: the Singapore Chinese Health Study
pmc-12751566.creator: Liyan Huang, Kevin Yiqiang Chua, Changzheng Yuan, Woon-Puay Koh
pmc-12751566.description: BackgroundAlthough Western studies have suggested that dietary carotenoids and flavonoids may reduce the risk of ageing-related physical frailty, evidence from prospective Asian studies is limited. We examined the association between midlife intake of these phytochemicals and risk of physical frailty among Chinese adults in Singapore.MethodsThis study included 10,738 participants from the population-based prospective cohort of the Singapore Chinese Health Study.

pmc-13054231.title: Integrated Radiomics Model Combining Diffusion Kurtosis Imaging and Dynamic Contrast‐Enhanced MRI for Predicting TERT Promoter Mutation Status in Gliomas
pmc-13054231.creator: Song Gao, Shenao Zhang, Yinjiao Wang, Lang Chen, Aihong Cao, Peng Du
pmc-13054231.description: PurposeThe purpose of this study is to investigate the value of a radiomics model based on diffusion kurtosis imaging (DKI) and dynamic contrast‐enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (DCE‐MRI) for preoperative prediction of telomerase reverse transcriptase (TERT) promoter mutation status in gliomas.

pmc-13384266.title: Sema3E‐plexinD1 Axis Is a Modulator of Foxp3+ Regulatory T‐Cells in House Dust Mite Model of Asthma
pmc-13384266.creator: Mojdeh Matloubi, Chukwunonso Onyilagha, Lianyu Shan, Sujata Basu, Andrew J Halayko, Mohamed Almiski, Abdelilah S Gounni
pmc-13384266.description: Airway epithelial cells (AEC) are the primary sources of Semaphorin3E (Sema3E) in human airways and its expression is downregulated in severe asthmatics, underscoring the AEC‐derived Sema3E critical role in lung homeostasis. Here, we investigated the effects of AEC‐derived Sema3E on immune responses in an acute house dust mite (HDM) asthma model.

pmc-13396728.title: Experimental and numerical study of adding TiO2 nanoparticles effect on the thermomechanical behavior of welded joints of Steel buildings
pmc-13396728.creator: Maria Norouzi, Amir Saedi Daryan, Mousa Mohammadpourfard, Saeed Zeinali Heris
pmc-13396728.description: This study investigates the impact of titanium dioxide (TiO2) nanoparticles on the thermomechanical behavior of L-shaped welded joints in steel structures. Nanoparticles were incorporated into the weld metal at three weight ratios (0.5, 1.25, and 2 wt%) using the cold spray coating technique, and the samples were heat-treated across a wide temperature range (25–900 °C).

pmc-13401008.title: Data-driven subclassification of type 2 diabetes in Mexico: a conceptual framework to improve diabetes care
pmc-13401008.creator: Mario Cesar Torres-Chávez, Jaretzy García-Manteca, Jacqueline A. Seiglie, Omar Yaxmehen Bello-Chavolla, Neftali Eduardo Antonio-Villa
pmc-13401008.description: SummaryType 2 diabetes (T2D) is a heterogeneous disease and a major public health concern in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). To address this heterogeneity, several subgroup classification frameworks have been proposed. Among them, the most widely used is the data-driven classification proposed by Ahlqvist et al.

pmc-13583302.title: A segmented computational method for deformation and dynamic characteristics analysis of deep-sea hydraulic valve
pmc-13583302.creator: Xinhao Li, Rourou Dong, Chuangting Xin, Jing Yao, Shuai Yang, Pei Wang, Yihan Ren
pmc-13583302.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Hydraulic systems serve as the primary drive mechanism for deep-sea submersibles. As these vehicles descend, ambient pressure increases from 0 to 110 MPa, inducing elastic deformation in the spool and sleeve that alters damping forces and compromises flow stability. To address this challenge, we propose a segmentation calculation method (SCM) that efficiently captures the dual nonlinear coupling between pressure distribution and cross-sectional geometry in predicting radial deformation.
